biotools.summary: NEFFy is a tool for calculating the Number of Effective Sequences (NEFF) for multiple sequence alignments of proteins, RNA, and DNA. It offers advanced features, scalability, and supports various MSA formats, alongside per-residue NEFF calculation and multimeric protein support.
